purpose: Commission the formula-neutral resolved velocity-field adapter on all thirteen real LITTLE THINGS moment maps and independently reproduce the frozen P0712 projection, beam, mask, and scoring operations.

observation.handednessRule: sign of intensity-and-dispersion-weighted observed major-axis covariance, shared by every model
observation.scoreMask: finite moment-0, moment-1, and moment-2; positive moment-0; nonnegative moment-2; inside registered HI r995
observation.emissionSupport: finite positive moment-0 and finite model prediction before beam convolution
observation.beam: measured elliptical AIPS CLEAN beam represented by the exact normalized P0712 Gaussian kernel

reporting.oldP0712Scores: report as a reconstruction/grid comparison only; do not use as an adapter parity gate

claimBoundary: P0731 is an engineering parity and spent-sample real-data run, not a new blind validation.
The P0723 33x33x9 generated baryonic replicas and their immutable acceleration fields are reused without changing any gravity parameter.
The zero_speed nonpositive-inward policy is declared solely to reproduce the frozen P0712 circular-speed convention; exclude remains the public default.
A velocity-field score tests the declared circular-equilibrium massive-tracer mapping and cannot validate pressure support, asymmetric drift, warps, radial flows, or photon lensing.
No ranking or formula selection is permitted from the adapter-parity gate.
